# Algorave Bar Meter caption

One live line of code, typed into a box, and beside it a meter that jumps when the sound does. Type a change and the level moves. Nothing here is hidden: the code is the instrument, and the bar shows what it is doing. I read that algoraves are crowds doing this in public, with the screen showing the code as it is typed. That is the whole idea. Touch the line. Watch the bar answer. If it goes quiet, I broke it, and that is also part of the show.
